title: Composer atlas
summary: Every state of the one composer and every transition between them: the levels of the bar, the floating bar and its icon, explore mode, the phone's sheet, the agent card's ladder, the notices and the chat's own states.
purpose: The single reference of the one composer. Each state has a name, what the person sees, its test id and a live thumbnail of the real component; each transition has its from-state, to-state, trigger (a button label, a key, a drag, an event, a resize) and guard (a width, a phone, a prop). The page and test/contracts/composer-atlas.test.mjs read one data file (ux/atlas/composer-atlas.json); the test drives every listed state and transition through the real controls, so the page cannot say what the code does not do. Built from kit parts and tokens only.

fixture.install: npx shadcn@4.23.0 add theme button card badge table input kbd
fixture.usage: import { Card } from '@/components/ui/card'  // the kit's parts, no app classes

notes: A reference page, not a flow: it has no gestures. The thumbnails of the shell's states are the design-system page in frames, loaded as they scroll into view; the transition table scrolls inside its own container on a phone.
